g.text: Title: ADS1299 core, reference and decoupling

g.desc: Title: ADS1299 core, reference and decoupling

g.text: +5VA: one 1 uF + 100 nF pair per AVDD pin (19, 21, 22, 56, 59) plus 10 uF bulk. Place each pair at its pin, return to AVSS.

g.desc: +5VA: one 1 uF + 100 nF pair per AVDD pin (19, 21, 22, 56, 59) plus 10 uF bulk. Place each pair at its pin, return to AVSS.

g.text: R101 feeds +3V3_ADC (ADC DVDD, clock oscillator) from +3V3; one 1 uF + 100 nF pair at DVDD pins 48 and 50, plus 10 uF bulk.

g.desc: R101 feeds +3V3_ADC (ADC DVDD, clock oscillator) from +3V3; one 1 uF + 100 nF pair at DVDD pins 48 and 50, plus 10 uF bulk.

g.text: External 2.048 MHz clock (CLKSEL low, adc_interface sheet); internal 4.5 V reference; per-channel REF selection on the input sheets. DC-coupled inputs.

g.desc: External 2.048 MHz clock (CLKSEL low, adc_interface sheet); internal 4.5 V reference; per-channel REF selection on the input sheets. DC-coupled inputs.

g.text: Eight differential inputs, BIAS amplifier and SRB pins (unit A), SPI and control (unit B), supplies and reference (unit C).

g.desc: Eight differential inputs, BIAS amplifier and SRB pins (unit A), SPI and control (unit B), supplies and reference (unit C).

g.text: SRB1/SRB2 unused and open; their internal switches must stay off. BIASIN and BIASREF pins tied to AVSS: firmware must set BIASREF_INT = 1.

g.desc: SRB1/SRB2 unused and open; their internal switches must stay off. BIASIN and BIASREF pins tied to AVSS: firmware must set BIASREF_INT = 1.

g.text: C121 needs >= 10 uF effective at 4.5 V after tolerance and DC bias. C116 (tantalum) positive terminal to VCAP1.

g.desc: C121 needs >= 10 uF effective at 4.5 V after tolerance and DC bias. C116 (tantalum) positive terminal to VCAP1.

g.text: ADS1299 CORE - all 64 package pins accounted for

g.desc: ADS1299 CORE - all 64 package pins accounted for

g.text: VCAP1-4 are internal bypass nodes, not supplies. VREFP decoupling to AVSS sets reference noise and settling.

g.desc: VCAP1-4 are internal bypass nodes, not supplies. VREFP decoupling to AVSS sets reference noise and settling.

g.text: R100 isolates the AVDD1 (charge-pump) pin 54 from the shared +5VA rail; its 1 uF + 100 nF pair sits at the pin.

g.desc: R100 isolates the AVDD1 (charge-pump) pin 54 from the shared +5VA rail; its 1 uF + 100 nF pair sits at the pin.
